# Vendored upstream source

`vendor/tribev2` is an unmodified source snapshot of Meta's official TRIBE v2
repository:

- repository: <https://github.com/facebookresearch/tribev2>
- commit: `af58661791a351a448a489042a28f6c37e1c14b7`
- commit date: 2026-06-23
- commit codeload tar SHA-256: `d28ec13086c4d5fc192d2d9bf600e004957ecd8c9de591fd7c592ab53268c151`
- upstream license: CC BY-NC 4.0; see `vendor/tribev2/LICENSE`

The snapshot was downloaded from GitHub's commit-addressed codeload endpoint. The
research code in `src/spfcl` adapts this snapshot without changing upstream files.
TRIBE v2's non-commercial license still applies to the vendored source.

The BOLD Moments download layout follows the authors' starter repository at commit
`56da232de1007c280b6fc9c2ae205f8befe71e0f` and OpenNeuro dataset `ds005165`,
snapshot `1.0.4`. The video archive is not mirrored here because its source datasets
have separate terms.
